messages.text: Your USB wall charger is eligible for a refund of **BRL 13.65**. Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; replying “yes” here won’t confirm it. After that, a staff member will review the request.
The customer confirmed request prop-1a2456593d234e96 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.
Your refund of **BRL 13.65** has been processed. Receipt number: **R-00000001**.
What date should the money reach my card?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"When does a card refund reach the customer's card after the refund is processed? Timing for card refund settlement."}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/scope", "title": "What this policy covers", "text": "This policy covers refunds for items in orders that the signed-in customer placed with the demo shop. All amounts are in BRL, and all times are the shop's clock in UTC. The shop and this policy are fictional: this is a demonstration, not the policy of any real shop and not legal advice."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: I don’t have a confirmed date for when the refund will appear on your card. The refund was processed on **October 21, 2026**; please check with your card issuer for their posting timeline.
Do you know if it should reach my card within a few days?
I can’t confirm whether it will arrive within a few days. Your card issuer can advise on its posting timeline.
